patch_description: Instead of the previous blind coordinate-descent polish over all points, this approach uses a fundamentally different paradigm: **worst-triangle targeted simulated annealing**. At each step we compute all 286 triangle areas vectorized, identify the bottom-k smallest ("bottleneck") triangles, and only perturb vertices involved in those bottlenecks. This concentrates search effort exactly where the objective is determined, avoiding wasted moves on already-good regions. Metropolis acceptance with a decaying temperature escapes local traps (addressing the greedy-climber problem), and a multi-start over several structured seeds (3-fold symmetric, hexagonal rings, jittered lattices) with a best-ever fallback guarantees robustness and determinism (fixed seeds). Points are kept inside the unit square; the objective is min-area / hull-area, so moves that shrink the hull are penalized automatically. Multi-scale reheats after the main anneal further refine.
